cases.query: I pulled this established repository onto a new machine. The team uses woostack, but this checkout has no .woostack directory, so set up the project-local workspace needed by the rest of the commands.

A bad merge removed .woostack/config.json and a few standard directories, while our existing memory and plans are intact. Restore only the missing workspace pieces and refresh anything derived from them.

All expected .woostack files are present, but several notes now fail metadata and provenance checks after a hand edit. Show me what is invalid and the safe corrections; don't apply them until I choose.
I've been away for a week. Which work items are active, how far has each pull-request stack progressed, and what should I pick up next?
